charts.title: HD 3167 c: orbits around HD 3167
charts.description: The orbits of HD 3167's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HD 3167 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Coy et al. 2026 (2026ApJ..1005L..77C), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname COY_ET_AL_2026): P 29.846511 d

charts.title: HD 3167 c: its transit
charts.description: HD 3167 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 1 sector (70) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 318707987, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 20-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 20-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
